sdc.daemon.ClientId.title: ClientId
sdc.daemon.ClientId.description: The client a session belongs to. UNMAPPED: what identifies a client (the subject of the bearer token, a name the client gives) is not stated in the design sheet; the daemon's security floor says only that a non-loopback listener needs a token.

sdc.daemon.SessionId.title: SessionId
sdc.daemon.SessionId.description: The name of a session, chosen by the client that opens it.
